ci-bot: 🚨 pipeline alert — main is red after merge by @olivia. failed job: gpu-smoke-alloc (stage: smoke). PR: #4321, commit abc1234.
olivia: I just merged a docs-only PR, surprised this triggered gpu alloc OOM.
maria: @olivia which commit sha? can you paste link?
olivia: olivia: commit abc1234 — https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/commit/abc1234
ajay: ajay: grabbing logs now. initial glance: kvalloc spike at ~00:02, allocation failed when spinning up shards.
tyler: tyler: pinging oncall — @sre-oncall can you take a look?
sre-oncall: sre-oncall: I'm oncall. pulling artifacts + test matrix. can someone rerun the failed job with full logs?
maria: maria: rerun requested (ci web): rerun job gpu-smoke-alloc (matrix entry batchsize=64) — queued.
ci-bot: ci-bot: rerun started by maria (job id: 1768591111-1)
ajay: ajay: FYI previous runs show occasional alloc blips when batchsize=64 + certain kernel versions. PR touched nothing in runtime but might have exercised different scheduling.
olivia: olivia: confirmed PR only docs; unclear why scheduler would change. might be infra flake.
ajay: ajay: paste from job log: 
```
[00:02:14] ERROR: AllocationError: failed to reserve 8.0 GiB for kv-cache on device gpu0
  at runtime/allocator.cc:142
  shard=3
  available=6.1 GiB
```
tyler: tyler: if rerun passes -> likely flake. if rerun fails -> we should bisect between last-green and this merge. hold on revert until we have bisect.
maria: maria: rerun finished: FAILED (again) — same allocation error.
sre-oncall: sre-oncall: ok starting bisect job set between build 1768490000 (last-green) and current. @ajay can you kick off minimal bisect (kernel/image differences)?
ajay: ajay: starting bisect now, running smaller matrix first to narrow down. will update thread.
olivia: olivia: sorry folks — standing by to revert if bisect points at my merge.
tyler: tyler: note: if bisect > 30m and customer-facing routes impacted, we'll escalate and open a hotfix revert. keep updates short. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: ci-bot: bisect job queued (bisect-range: 1768490000..1768591111).
ajay: ajay: quick update — first bisect slice still reproduces failure on image 2026-02-22-kernel-5.17. running next slice to isolate layer.
maria: maria: thanks @ajay. if you need extra GPU quota ping me and I'll raise.
sre-oncall: sre-oncall: acknowledged. I'll watch the bisect results and widen resources if it stalls.
tyler: tyler: tagging owners to keep eyes: @maria @ajay @olivia.
ajay: ajay: will post result as soon as slice completes (ETA ~7m).
maria: maria: thx, keeping this thread for coordination.
